# geohash

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:geohash`](gmeow-geohash.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/geohash>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A geohash string — a hierarchical spatial indexing system encoding latitude and longitude into a base32 string (e.g. 'u4pruydqqvj').
